arms.free: reserved for M3266; no mode constraint
arms.grip: max body sideslip <= 0.12 rad through the obstacle pass
arms.slide: body sideslip >= 0.20 rad for >= 4 control steps before obstacle center, with rear lateral utilization >= 0.90

decision_rule.admit_m3266: all positive-control, planar mode-expressibility, search-health, determinism, and Chrono connector gates pass
decision_rule.block_and_reprice: any gate fails; do not interpret absence of a drift-only cell

forbidden_claims: universal no-drift theorem for detailed vehicles

primary_scope.actuators: matched steering, throttle, and brake authority in both arms
primary_scope.initial_state: pre-slip, straight or explicitly bounded incipient-slip state
primary_scope.terminal_requirement: collision-free pass with common road/progress constraints; no terminal yaw target

public_gates.chrono_connector: both structured profiles return finite obs72 and finite tire-slip telemetry
public_gates.claim_guard: M3265 prices the proof route only and cannot establish dominance
public_gates.planar_mode_expressibility: each frozen cell yields at least one mode-valid grip and slide candidate
public_gates.search_health: best score is finite and each arm writes iteration history

research_question: Is the dual-proof route capable of detecting a known larger-control-set drift-only witness, finding both grip-bounded and deliberate-slide candidates under matched plant semantics, and collecting Chrono tire truth before a full reachable-set adjudication?

search.action_mapping: physical pedals in [0,1] are mapped to repo-normalized [-1,1] before stepping
search.optimizer: matched-budget CEM over piecewise-constant physical steer/throttle/brake commands
